records.trigger: AB-001-bin-rename: the user asked to rename the command tool to proof-or-stop, so invoking the tool under the new name must succeed.
records.observedFailure: Observed on baseline HEAD in the B-cdf6 worktree: (1) `command -v proof-or-stop` exits 1 - the name does not resolve on PATH; (2) `node bin/proof-or-stop.js --version` throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND from node:internal/modules/cjs/loader because bin/proof-or-stop.js does not exist; bin/ contains only bootstrap-runner.js, lattice-codex.js and lattice.js. Control observation proving the harness itself works: `node bin/lattice.js --version` succeeds and prints 'Proofbound CLI 0.3.251', which additionally exhibits the legacy product-name string this story normalizes to Proof-or-Stop.
records.note: Red evidence for the rename's central user-visible claim. The red state is definitional rather than a defect: the new bin genuinely does not exist yet, so the failing command is the honest pre-state. Green is reached by CHK-002 adding the bin entry plus wrapper, at which point the same command prints the version. The lattice control invocation is recorded so a reviewer can distinguish 'new name missing' from 'CLI broken in this worktree'.
